items.title: Article: Eliminating Long-Lived Credentials in GCP with Workload Identity Federation
items.summary: Long-lived GCP service account keys are secrets that must be managed forever, are hard to rotate, and are easy to leak. Scaling Workload Identity Federation to 120+ production projects shows why it changes how machine identity is approached entirely: keys are secrets to manage, federated identities are trust relationships configured once, gated by attribute conditions. By Shijin Nair

items.title: AWS Open Sources Kiro Crew for Asynchronous Coding Agents

By Renato Losio

He shares practical approaches using WebGPU, Transformers.js, and DuckDB to achieve near-native performance in JavaScript. Through real-world case studies, he explains how to minimize data privacy risks, optimize browser inference, and build rigorous evaluation suites. By James Hall

items.title: FlexGanttFX is Open Source

The framework includes features for task dependency modeling and direct editing, accommodating diverse project planning needs. By Erik Costlow
